args.title: Clear stale problem message when a new file is selected
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

In the file input's onChange handler, call setProblem(null) when a new file is selected (not only inside handleSubmit on submit), so the previous error/row message is cleared as soon as the user picks a different file.

args.title: Fix duplicate report name truncation to preserve '(copy)' suffix
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

In the POST /reports/:id/duplicate handler, truncate the source name first (reserving room for ' (copy)') before appending the suffix, instead of truncating the combined string. This ensures the duplicated name always ends with ' (copy)' and stays within MAX_NAME_LENGTH, rather than having the suffix replaced by '...'.

args.title: Preserve non-Latin letters in slugify for export filenames
args.body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

Update slugify() so that after NFKD normalization it allows Unicode letter categories (e.g. Greek, Cyrillic) through instead of stripping everything outside [a-z0-9], while still removing unsafe filename characters. This will stop formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts from falling back to 'report' when export names use non-Latin scripts.

args.title: Use local time zone instead of UTC for export filename date
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

formatExportFilename() currently builds the date suffix with at.toISOString().slice(0,10), which always yields the UTC calendar date. It should instead derive the date from the exporting user's local time zone (e.g. using an Intl.DateTimeFormat-based helper similar to dates.ts's localHour/formatDay pattern) so the filename date matches the day the user actually exported on.
